This gives the correct character as signed cellular edge trace minus vertex trace plus one, times the bipartition sign. value.rationale: Full automorphism action on the first post-girth Rips homology of canonical incidence graphs is a natural, motivated invariant: their known wedge rank q^3 cannot distinguish an irreducible group action, a trivial one, or their duality signs. On the Fano graph the eight-dimensional module is absolutely irreducible under the full 336-element symmetry group and contains no invariant vector; its nine-class character is now explicitly determined. The exact polarity trace equals absolute-point count minus one, distinguishing orthogonal and unitary polarities of PG(2,4) in a common rank-64 homology space. These geometric and representation-theoretic distinctions, not a small change to a Betti count, supply the substantive mathematical value. The formal cover sign alone would be weaker than the jointly verified full character.
